import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectiveTwistTransition

/-!
# Nonvanishing of homogeneous projective ratios

The basic open cut out by `p / X_i^m` on `D_+(X_i)` is
`D_+(X_i) ∩ D_+(p)` for every homogeneous `p` of positive degree `m`.
The coordinate-overlap formula is its degree-one specialization.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u v

open CategoryTheory Opposite MvPolynomial HomogeneousLocalization
open AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne.ProjectiveTwist

noncomputable section

variable {k : Type (max u v)} [Field k] {J : Type v}

attribute [local instance] MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra

private theorem basicOpen_iota_eq (i : J) :
    (chart (k := k) i).ι =
      Proj.basicOpenToSpec (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i) ≫
        Proj.awayι (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)
          (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) Nat.zero_lt_one := by
  rw [← Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_inv_ι (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)
      (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) Nat.zero_lt_one,
    ← Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_hom (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)
      (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) Nat.zero_lt_one,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

/-- On the standard chart, the ratio `p / X_i^m` is nonzero exactly where
the positive-degree homogeneous polynomial `p` is nonzero. -/
theorem basicOpen_homogeneousRatio (i : J) (p : MvPolynomial J k) {m : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ homogeneousSubmodule J k m) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule J k)).basicOpen
      ((Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)).hom
        (Away.isLocalizationElem (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) hp)) =
      chart (k := k) i ⊓ Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule J k) p := by
  have hpre : (chart (k := k) i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
        ((Proj (homogeneousSubmodule J k)).basicOpen
          ((Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)).hom
            (Away.isLocalizationElem (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) hp))) =
      (chart (k := k) i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
        Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule J k) p := by
    rw [← Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_preimage_basicOpen]
    conv_rhs =>
      rw [basicOpen_iota_eq (k := k) i]
    change _ = Proj.basicOpenToSpec (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i) ⁻¹ᵁ
      (Proj.awayι (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)
        (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) Nat.zero_lt_one ⁻¹ᵁ
          Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule J k) p)
    rw [Proj.awayι_preimage_basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule J k)
      (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) Nat.one_pos hp hm]
    rfl
  have himg := congrArg (fun W => (chart (k := k) i).ι ''ᵁ W) hpre
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
    Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι] at himg
  have hle : (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule J k)).basicOpen
      ((Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)).hom
        (Away.isLocalizationElem (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) hp)) ≤
      Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i) :=
    (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule J k)).basicOpen_le _
  calc
    (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule J k)).basicOpen
        ((Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)).hom
          (Away.isLocalizationElem (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) hp)) =
        Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i) ⊓
          (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule J k)).basicOpen
            ((Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i)).hom
              (Away.isLocalizationElem (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) hp)) :=
      (inf_eq_right.mpr hle).symm
    _ = Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule J k) (X i) ⊓
        Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule J k) p := himg

/-- The coordinate `X_j / X_i` is nonzero exactly on the overlap of the two
standard projective charts. -/
theorem basicOpen_coordinate (i j : J) :
    (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule J k)).basicOpen (coordinate (k := k) i j) =
      chart (k := k) i ⊓ chart (k := k) j := by
  have h := basicOpen_homogeneousRatio (k := k) i (X j)
    (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one j) Nat.one_pos
  convert h using 2
  simp [coordinate, ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord, Away.isLocalizationElem]

end

end Hartshorne.ProjectiveTwist
